en: ♾️ New Timeless mode: no clock, take your time on every tile. You can also remove all powers before you start. Your best shows on your profile.
⛓️ New power: Chains (no Rotate or Flip for 10 seconds)
🧪 New power: Acid (a 3×2 patch of blocks melts away)
🏎️ New Racing and 🍩 Sweets board themes with their own music
🗺 Adventure fix: powers can no longer ruin stars and other goals
📰 This What's New window now appears after every update
fil: ♾️ Bagong Timeless mode: walang orasan, dahan-dahan sa bawat tile. Puwede mo ring alisin lahat ng power bago magsimula. Makikita ang best mo sa profile.
⛓️ Bagong power: Kadena (bawal Ikutin o Baligtarin nang 10 segundo)
🧪 Bagong power: Asido (natutunaw ang 3×2 na bahagi ng mga block)
🏎️ Bagong Karera at 🍩 Matatamis na board theme, may sariling music
🗺 Ayos sa Adventure: hindi na masisira ng power ang mga star at ibang layunin
📰 Lalabas na ang What's New na window pagkatapos ng bawat update
